ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: an absent projection result is POLICY_DENIED: errors must not disclose existence (NFR-006, Register :50)
a quarantined projection is PROJECTION_NOT_READY with the served watermark (LLD v1.1 :350)
a call above the cost budget of its contract is POLICY_DENIED before the read (LLD v1.1 :120 fixes no code)
a context policy effect other than PERMIT (PERMIT_WITH_CONSTRAINTS, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, OBLIGATE) is POLICY_DENIED for reads: the gateway enforces no obligation

an absent or empty governed-context field on the wire is POLICY_DENIED (ADD v1.3 :380); a malformed wire digest is SCHEMA_VIOLATION (PO NCR-C2-008 option 2); a principal or actor_chain in the body is SCHEMA_VIOLATION (closed QueryContext)

the served context of an error carries the request classification_marking_ref as result_marking_ref and the content address of the served observation as provenance_ref (both mandatory in the contract ServedContext)
GetProvenance (no contract call in ProvenanceRequest) is served by the provenance contract registered in the active release; without one it is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY
redaction_count counts distinct withheld resources (objects, links, graph targets)
EXACT_AT_COMMIT waits within wait_timeout_ms while the projection is behind; once overtaken it answers PROJECTION_NOT_READY immediately
a code outside the closed enum raised by a sealed spike adapter behind ProjectionReadPort is answered POLICY_DENIED
a transport-stage rejection is audited with the authenticated principal; an absent correlation id is recorded as 'unparsed-request'

a branch other than the one the C4 projections serve (main), or any scenario_id, is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: the canonical projection never answers for another branch or a scenario world, and the norm fixes no other code (LLD v1.1 :126 only requires main and scenario to be declared)

a context-policy answer that is not a PolicyDecision, or a decision that does not verify against the request (expired, other principal, action, resource, purpose, GCS digest or bundle), is a policy that cannot be evaluated: CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE on the read (ADD v1.3 :3141), audited with outcome FAILED

a transport identity refused by the security port (IDENTITY_EXPIRED, ANONYMOUS_IDENTITY_FORBIDDEN, IDENTITY_BINDING_MISMATCH, PRINCIPAL_BINDING_MISMATCH) is AUTHORITY_MISSING (contract :455), audited; an unavailable control stays CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE (ADD v1.3 :174)
CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE answers are also audited (outcome FAILED); if that audit cannot be made durable the answer stays CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE

in a page, redactions are counted only for withheld objects between the first and the last returned object; withheld objects after the last returned object, and the start objects of a walk, are neither counted nor hinted at

a malformed or tampered row of the object projection fails the whole read with CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE (no partial answer); a stored audit row that is malformed or tampered is an audit integrity failure (AUDIT_RECORD_INVALID, or AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN for a link hash)
an evidence read without a transport-bound query is SCHEMA_VIOLATION and cannot be audited with an actor: no principal exists to record
